output.answer_markdown: The passages do not state any gain accruing to Johnson & Johnson from the separation of its Consumer Health business (Kenvue) as of August 30, 2023. J&J's materials only say it intends to "split off" Kenvue shares through an exchange offer [2] and that the separation was announced in November 2021 [6]. The $8.1 billion pre-tax gain in the passages belongs to Pfizer's Consumer Healthcare JV with GSK, not to J&J [1].

found: J&J intends to "split off" Kenvue shares through an exchange offer, subject to market conditions (Q2 2023 earnings release).
In November 2021, J&J announced its intention to separate its Consumer Health business (Kenvue).
The $8.1 billion pre-tax gain in the passages relates to Pfizer's Consumer Healthcare JV with GSK, not J&J.
missing: A J&J disclosure of any gain or loss on the Kenvue separation or exchange offer, dated as of or near August 30, 2023.
refusal.reason: The passages contain no figure for a gain recognized by Johnson & Johnson from the separation of its Consumer Health business (Kenvue) as of August 30, 2023.
